label: fed-back w early in a short copy, near the end
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, when the input fed back is the letter w (99.9% of activation mass is on in_tok == w). Never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on any other input token. Among copy-phase w inputs it is restricted to w that was one of the first four original tokens (recall_idx 1-4) and to steps where at most 2 outputs remain (to_go <= 2), so in practice it fires on short sequences (L = 3-6; L = 4 alone holds about half the mass). The largest activations are in L = 3 sequences where w is original token 1, fed back at recall_idx 2 (e.g. 2 w 1 <DEL> 2 [w]). It is weak or silent on w in long sequences and on w recalled far from the end. out_tok, next_out and prev tokens have little effect.

issues: The core claims hold up. All mass is in the copy phase (original phase and delimiter: 0 activations). in_tok == w holds 0.999 of the mass. L=4 holds 0.516 of the mass. The top examples are L=3 sequences with w at original index 1, fed back at recall_idx 2 (e.g. '2 w 1 <DEL> 2 [w]').

The predicate contradicts its own explanation. The explanation says the feature is limited to L = 3-6, but recall_idx <= 4 & to_go <= 2 also lets in L=7 (recall_idx 4, to_go 2). That cell is a systematic false-positive class: dev precision 0.198 on about 2750 steps, mass 0.007. It accounts for roughly 2200 of the about 5800 test false positives. The 'misses' output shows this directly, e.g. 'r q f w r o x <DEL> r q f *w*' is inactive.

The edge of the firing region is graded, not sharp. Dev precision by (recall_idx, to_go): (3,2) 0.61, (4,0) 0.69, (4,1) 0.51, (4,2) 0.20, (3,3) 0.21. So 'fires only when both conditions hold' overclaims. Activation fades smoothly as L and recall_idx grow. Missed activations are low-magnitude (3.2% of mass), mostly w at recall_idx >= 5 or to_go >= 3.
No hidden history factor explains the false positives at the edge. Within the recall_idx == 4 cells, splitting by n_digits or by in_count (whether w repeats) moves precision only from 0.42 to 0.56.
Adding L <= 6 to the predicate (which drops the L=7 cell) raises test F1 from 0.811 to 0.839 (precision 0.837, recall 0.841, mass recall 0.962).
skeptic.revised_label: fed-back w in the copy phase of short sequences (L<=6), recalled among the first 4 positions near the end; strength fades gradually with L
